classification_rationale: the plugin-OS-call deadline in agent core is absent; tracked in #3925
trigger: NetShareEnum blocks on a wedged (not stopped) Server service on a dispatch-pool worker with no deadline
summary: NetShareEnum has no deadline; a wedged srvsvc parks the dispatch worker and blocks thread_pool_.reset() on reconnect. Same class as NetUserEnum, TAR NetSessionEnum and the VSS call; ruled deferred-to-issue #3925 for the VSS case. A KNOWN OPERATIONAL HAZARD banner and the README 'memory, not time' sentence disclose it.

classification_rationale: a drifted enumeration was reported supported
trigger: shares created or deleted between NetShareEnum pages (resume handle is an index into the live list)
summary: A share could be silently skipped or duplicated while the result read supported. Fixed: ASCII-case-insensitive dedupe uncharged to the budget, no_progress when a MORE_DATA page keeps nothing new, and constrained inconsistent_drain when a multi-page drain ends with a count different from the first page's totalentries.

policy_floor: CLAUDE.md standing rule: C++ resource ownership and lifetime (routed-concerns.md, cpp-safety on any C++ source change)
classification_rationale: the level/Info pairing and cast lifetime were undocumented and unenforced
trigger: level and Info passed separately to one_page so the reinterpret_cast pairing was unenforced
summary: Policy floor: a cast resting on undocumented aliasing and lifetime. Fixed: level derived from Info (constexpr, static_assert restricting Info to SHARE_INFO_1/2) and the buffer-lifetime comment added.

classification_rationale: comment and docs stated a bound the API does not guarantee
trigger: the Server service does not honour prefmaxlen, so a page is larger than 64 KiB
summary: The 'API never hands over the whole inventory' and 'two orders of magnitude' wording over-claimed. Fixed: wording says 64 KiB is requested, not guaranteed, and bounds memory not time (about 50x under LAN Manager limits).

classification_rationale: docs described Windows rows as never hidden
trigger: a user-created non-special share whose name ends in $ (for example exfil$)
summary: Windows shares were typed but never flagged hidden, so a hidden user share looked like a plain disk. Fixed: hidden flag for any non-special name ending in $; special stays special, order kind,hidden,temporary.

classification_rationale: tests pinning byte-budget charging and the fallback reset were absent
trigger: byte-budget charging and the field_oversized reset on fallback had surviving mutants
summary: Four of 22 mutants of list_windows survived. Fixed: a byte-budget cut case, a fallback restart case, a 64-call guard on the fake pager, and (code-review r2 / governance r2) the cyclic, duplicate, drain-mismatch and terminal empty-page cases.

classification_rationale: two changelog fragments disagreed about the Windows leg
trigger: an operator reads the older unreleased shares changelog fragment
summary: The unreleased fragment still said the Windows leg reported unsupported and contradicted the new fragment; the stopped-service sentence needed 'per the API contract'. Fixed in both fragments.

classification_rationale: help text described a shipped leg as planned
trigger: an operator reads the shares.list help text served by help, palette and discover
summary: The help string still said Windows is planned. Fixed to describe the live Windows enumeration and the macOS-only planned leg.

trigger: a reader of the new changelog fragment
summary: The fragment claimed a share created or deleted during a run is always reported as constrained; the check only fires on a multi-page drain whose final count differs from the first total. Fixed to the narrower truth already in the README.

classification_rationale: a locale-dependent fold remained after the sibling fold was made ASCII-only
trigger: smb_canon still folded keys with the locale-dependent std::tolower
summary: Same defect class as the fixed detail::lower; smb_canon now uses the locale-free fold. No behaviour change in the C locale.

trigger: an operator reads the instruction description for the non-admin service identity
summary: An unmeasured level-1 fallback was stated as fact. Reworded as predicted per the NetShareEnum contract and not yet measured; the Server Operators remedy now notes it is a domain-controller group.

classification_rationale: token explanation omitted a known false-positive cause
trigger: a stable multi-page host where totalentries (documented as a hint) disagrees with the count
summary: The inconsistent_drain token row named only a real create/delete; the false-positive risk was disclosed only in caveat 3. The row now names the hint disagreement too. The risk itself stays unmeasured (no multi-page host observed).
